answer: Forge tax stops fakes: each identity pays tax at the forge, rising per extra identity from one root. The first pays 40; the k-th pays 40+12(k-1). Each receipt bears a key-bound velvet seal, posted on the ledge board, where an auditor replays velvet seals and strikes failures. A rented-receipt ring fails: seals carry the seller's key. 1,000 fakes from one root cost 6,034,000 for a 40,000 share. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its share.
